name: Synthacon
tagline: Gear near you, from people who play
voice: A musician talking to another musician, never a brand talking at a customer. Plain, informed, peer-to-peer; the simplest word that carries the meaning; earn every adjective. Marketplace + community to buy, sell, and rent studio and music gear, in open beta; the rent/lend angle is the story. CTA: Join the beta. HARD rules: no marketing-speak category labels, no fake or invented metrics (prefer no numbers at all during beta), no em-dashes in any public copy, no unshipped features. Marketing palette is violet, white, and black ONLY: the S mark renders in ink (white) with its two identity dots, accents stay in the violet family (#a090dc / #b8a8f0), no gold or yellow anywhere, no glow, no bloom. In product screenshots green means success/online only and red means error only. Prices and data render in JetBrains Mono.
